_doc: Map storefront product slugs → MegaHouse product-page URLs on the
official English storefront, en.megahobby.jp (a Shopify store).
The adapter appends `.json` to the URL to read Shopify's structured
product document: English body_html → description, the YYYY-MM tag
An empty string is a scaffold placeholder: the slug is staged but no
URL has been filled in yet. Empty entries are inert — the adapter
All mapped slugs are EXISTING storefront rows (status='available')
missing images / description, so there is no `line` field and no
draft creation — the adapter only proposes data for review.
